notes.title: Bug Fix and tutorial
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!
I've worked on this update from the release day. I've fixed some minor bug and added a tutorial.

Let me know if anything is broken and I'm gonna fix it in the next update (that should also contains more music)

Nikolaj

notes.title: Release and next steps
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]A few days passed from the release and I still need to realize that I was able to complete this incredible task.[/p][p][/p][p]For the ones that doesn't know, I made this game in my free time during the last 2 years. I've learned so much during this time, finding the motivation to push and continuing to work wasn't easy but I'm happy with the result.[/p][p][/p][p]But the work isn't over![/p][p]In the following weeks I want to work on fixing some known bugs, adding some more music and other small details.[/p][p][/p][p]So a big thanks to everyone that bought the game and that are supporting me.[/p][p]I'll see you on the next patch[/p]

notes.title: Demo update and wip
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,
In the last months I've been working a lot on the game in order to remove the majority of the known bugs and on the game structure as a whole.
In this last update I've added the customization infastructure, the minimap, a new map and the story mode. 
I'm really happy to see how this game is being going, but the road is still long.

Do you like the game so far?

Nikolaj

notes.title: Demo Patch 0
notes.notes:
Buonsalve,
I want to start this little patch note with a huge thank you to all of you.
Seeing my first "real" work being played by so many of you is an amazing feeling.

And now we can continue with the boring info:
After many weeks of battle with unreal I was able to fully support the gamepad. I had to restruct a huge portion of the ui but I'm happy with the result even if I know is not perfect (but I need to prioritize other things now)

After seing more people playing the game I was convinced to add a minimap in order to make it clear the race track.

Last but not least, with the help of a steam discussion I became aware of some bugs in the loading and saving of some of the settings. Now the infestations should be exterminated but if you see some other pests let me know.

The next things that I need to add are a system for selecting a race, a tutorial and then all the rest of the game .-.

One patch at a time, I'll end this game

Nikolaj
